note: Two reusable rules are supported by the story issue and completion review.

candidates.text: Migration integration tests must build the schema by applying the ordered migration/bootstrap path, not by marking migrations applied while fabricating only selected tables.
candidates.rationale: The Story 014 fixture marked migrations 001–010 as applied without creating their schema, causing a later migration to fail with no such table: tasks; applying the real sequence fixed it.

candidates.text: Do not add files outside a story's declared scope without explicit approval or an updated scope record.
candidates.rationale: The completion review found that two new test files exceeded Story 041's allowed file list; the remediation required consolidating them into an allowed file.
